heading: Restriction on use of Federal funds under health care programs

tree.heading: Restriction on Federal funding of health care services
tree.text: Subject to subsection (b), no funds appropriated by Congress for the purpose of paying (directly or indirectly) for the provision of health care services may be used—

children.text: to provide any health care item or service furnished for the purpose of causing, or for the purpose of assisting in causing, the death of any individual, such as by assisted suicide, euthanasia, or mercy killing;

to pay (directly, through payment of Federal financial participation or other matching payment, or otherwise) for such an item or service, including payment of expenses relating to such an item or service; or
to pay (in whole or in part) for health benefit coverage that includes any coverage of such an item or service or of any expenses relating to such an item or service.

tree.heading: Construction and treatment of certain services
tree.text: Nothing in subsection (a), or in any other provision of this chapter (or in any amendment made by this chapter), shall be construed to apply to or to affect any limitation relating to—

children.text: the withholding or withdrawing of medical treatment or medical care;
the withholding or withdrawing of nutrition or hydration;
abortion; or

the use of an item, good, benefit, or service furnished for the purpose of alleviating pain or discomfort, even if such use may increase the risk of death, so long as such item, good, benefit, or service is not also furnished for the purpose of causing, or the purpose of assisting in causing, death, for any reason.

tree.heading: Limitation on Federal facilities and employees
tree.text: Subject to subsection (b), with respect to health care items and services furnished— no such item or service may be furnished for the purpose of causing, or for the purpose of assisting in causing, the death of any individual, such as by assisted suicide, euthanasia, or mercy killing.

children.text: by or in a health care facility owned or operated by the Federal government, or
by any physician or other individual employed by the Federal government to provide health care services within the scope of the physician’s or individual’s employment,

tree.heading: List of programs to which restrictions apply

children.heading: Federal health care funding programs
children.text: Subsection (a) applies to funds appropriated under or to carry out the following:

children.heading: Medicare program
children.text: Title XVIII of the Social Security Act [42 U.S.C. 1395 et seq.].

children.heading: Medicaid program
children.text: Title XIX of the Social Security Act [42 U.S.C. 1396 et seq.].

children.heading: Title XX social services block grant
children.text: Title XX of the Social Security Act [42 U.S.C. 1397 et seq.].

children.heading: Maternal and child health block grant program
children.text: Title V of the Social Security Act [42 U.S.C. 701 et seq.].

children.heading: Public Health Service Act
children.text: The Public Health Service Act [42 U.S.C. 201 et seq.].

children.heading: Indian Health Care Improvement Act
children.text: The Indian Health Care Improvement Act [25 U.S.C. 1601 et seq.].

children.heading: Federal employees health benefits program
children.text: Chapter 89 of title 5.

children.heading: Military health care system (including Tricare and CHAMPUS programs)
children.text: Chapter 55 of title 10.

children.heading: Veterans medical care
children.text: Chapter 17 of title 38.

children.heading: Health services for Peace Corps volunteers
children.text: Section 2504(e) of title 22.

children.heading: Medical services for Federal prisoners
children.text: Section 4005(a) of title 18.

children.heading: Federal facilities and personnel
children.text: The provisions of subsection (c) apply to facilities and personnel of the following:

children.heading: Military health care system
children.text: The Department of Defense operating under chapter 55 of title 10.

children.heading: Veterans medical care
children.text: The Veterans Health Administration of the Department of Veterans Affairs.

children.heading: Public Health Service
children.text: The Public Health Service.

children.heading: Nonexclusive list
children.text: Nothing in this subsection shall be construed as limiting the application of subsection (a) to the programs specified in paragraph (1) or the application of subsection (c) to the facilities and personnel specified in paragraph (2).

notes.heading: References in Text
notes.text: This chapter, referred to in subsec. (b), was in the original “this Act”, meaning Pub. L. 105–12, Apr. 30, 1997, 111 Stat. 23, known as the Assisted Suicide Funding Restriction Act of 1997, which is classified principally to this chapter. For complete classification of this Act to the Code, see Short Title note set out under section 14401 of this title and Tables. The Social Security Act, referred to in subsec. (d)(1)(A)–(D), is act Aug. 14, 1935, ch. 531, 49 Stat. 620. Titles V, XVIII, XIX, and XX of the Act are classified generally to subchapters V (§ 701 et seq.), XVIII (§ 1395 et seq.), XIX (§ 1396 et seq.), and XX (§ 1397 et seq.), respectively, of chapter 7 of this title, respectively. For complete classification of this Act to the Code, see section 1305 of this title and Tables. The Public Health Service Act, referred to in subsec. (d)(1)(E), is act July 1, 1944, ch. 373, 58 Stat. 682, which is classified generally to chapter 6A (§ 201 et seq.) of this title. For complete classification of this Act to the Code, see Short Title note set out under section 201 of this title and Tables. The Indian Health Care Improvement Act, referred to in subsec. (d)(1)(F), is Pub. L. 94–437,
